classification.difficultyReason: Read fractional subdivisions beyond whole numbers and express the marked positions as mixed numerals.

content.prompt: Which numbers correspond to the star, the triangle and the heart on each number line?

spec.description: Integers 4–7 labelled below a number line divided into sevenths, continuing through six intermediate ticks after 7. Custom TikZ preserves the star, heart and downward triangle, which the number-line template cannot express.
spec.mathematics: Star at 4+4/7; heart at 5+6/7; triangle at 7+3/7.
spec.answerVisibility: Symbols and integer labels are permanent givens; fractional values are hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
Each unit is divided into seven equal intervals, so each interval represents $\frac{1}{7}$.

The star is four intervals after $4$: $4\frac{4}{7}$.

The triangle is three intervals after $7$: $7\frac{3}{7}$.

The heart is six intervals after $5$: $5\frac{6}{7}$.

spec.description: Integers 23–31 labelled below a number line divided into sixths, with five intermediate ticks after 31. Custom TikZ preserves the distinct star, downward triangle and heart markers.
spec.mathematics: Star at 24+3/6; triangle at 27+5/6; heart at 30+2/6.
spec.answerVisibility: Symbols and integer labels are permanent givens; fractional values are hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
Each unit is divided into six equal intervals, so each interval represents $\frac{1}{6}$.

The star is three intervals after $24$: $24\frac{3}{6}=24\frac{1}{2}$.

The triangle is five intervals after $27$: $27\frac{5}{6}$.

The heart is two intervals after $30$: $30\frac{2}{6}=30\frac{1}{3}$.
